name: Ratify the check-in as the shift-native form of the 1:1
text_content:
Type: founder decision

The check-in replaces her 1:1: fifteen minutes on the clock as the first fifteen minutes of a scheduled shift, in the pre-service window, placed by the stack when the interval elapses, with a three-question spine, an upward question, and one written line on the person page. Intervals: every two weeks in the ninety-day plan, monthly after. It surfaced because the carryover named the function as non-optional and the form as unsurvivable at tempo (sections 4.1 to 4.7, P15 to P21).

Filed by Session 4 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmhjr. Reasoning lives on the S4 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
